story.iWant: to manage my preferences and industry associations through a unified, intuitive interface
story.soThat: I can personalize my experience and showcase my professional background efficiently
story.tasks: - Create Preferences Management Page Structure (AC: 2.3.1) - Theme Preference Selector with Live Preview (AC: 2.3.2) - Layout Density Selector with Visual Examples (AC: 2.3.3) - Font Size Selector with Preview Text (AC: 2.3.4) - Industry Management Section (AC: 2.3.5, 2.3.7) - Industry Search and Filter Functionality (AC: 2.3.6) - Preference Change Management (AC: 2.3.8, 2.3.9, 2.3.11) - Form Validation and Error Handling (AC: 2.3.10, 2.3.14) - Responsive Design Implementation (AC: 2.3.12) - Accessibility Implementation (AC: 2.3.13) - Integration with Existing APIs (AC: 2.3.8, 2.3.9) - Testing and Validation (AC: 2.3.15)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Comprehensive Preferences page created with unified navigation (theme, layout, font size, industries) 2. Theme preference selector with live preview of theme changes before saving 3. Layout density selector with visual examples (compact, comfortable, spacious) 4. Font size selector with preview text showing size differences 5. Industry management section with add, remove, set primary, and reorder capabilities 6. Industry search/filter functionality for finding industries quickly 7. Visual indicators for primary vs secondary industries 8. Preference changes save to backend API with proper error handling 9. Preference persistence and restoration on page load 10. Real-time validation feedback for all preference inputs 11. Undo/Reset functionality to revert unsaved preference changes 12. Responsive design for mobile and tablet devices 13. Accessibility compliance with keyboard navigation and screen reader support 14. Loading states and error messages for all async operations 15. Comprehensive UAT tests validate all preference management workflows

Integration testing for cross-domain functionality. End-to-end testing for complete user workflows. Performance testing for preference change speed.
